author_source_notes.2: V6 addition: The historical Meituan INFORMS TSL research sample covers 17–24 Oct 2022. Existing team aggregates keep one grabbed/delivered waybill per order with a promised time, then separate non-prebooked orders. N=546,364; share late_any=0.1478; share late_over_10min=0.0141. On-slide rounding is 14.8% and 1.4%. These are delivery-delay shares in that research sample, not 2026 platform complaint rates or measured financial losses. No raw data is redistributed. Source: https://github.com/meituan/Meituan-INFORMS-TSL-Research-Challenge ; work/data/meituan_lateness_stats.json and .py. Required attribution: This research was supported by data provided by Meituan.
author_source_notes.6: V6 addition: Model selection is explained as a practical study choice: use the already-working DeepSeek tool-calling implementation for the demo, with developer-reported low development/demo cost; formal runs use the owner-selected GPT-5.6 API with the same settings for B and C and preserved request/usage logs. This does not claim a pre-run latency/stability competition or that either model beat alternative models. Existing formal configuration and measured results remain unchanged.
author_source_notes.13: V6 addition: Proposed rollout only; no shadow run, real-order pilot or expansion has been executed. First resolve the pending goodwill policy, fix the observed explanation/intent/promise defects and pass affected regression paths. Shadow suggestions remain read-only and humans decide. A limited real-order pilot requires validated, authorized production interfaces; human approval remains on every issue. Advance only after no wrong/duplicate issues and reviewed safety checks in the pilot. Gradual scaling needs measured net time savings including review/rework, a positive local cost case and rollback/monitoring. No numerical pilot performance is asserted. Existing 14+6+3 B failures, C6 unsupported promises and C9 pending cases are retained. Later transfer to e-commerce requires new connectors and policy revalidation.
